QuestInfo.name: Kiku the Training Instructor
QuestInfo.0: As stated by #p1101002#, you have to first raise your level to 10 and become a Knight-in-Training. You have to visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and enter the Training Forest.
QuestInfo.1: You met with #p1102000# at the entrance of the Training Forest. According to #p1102000#, Ereve is bereft of monsters, and instead, everyone trains against fantasy creatures created by #p1101001# called 'Mimi'. He then proceeded to give you a potion called #p1102000#...
QuestInfo.2: #p1102000# shot a warning saying that training will be tough. You better pack up the potions that he gave you and get ready for the training.
